sections.shortTitle: Establishment of the Office of Ombudsman for The Province of Sindh Amendment Act 2012
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT IX OF 2012
ACT IX OF 2012
ESTABLISHMENT OF THE OFFICE OF OMBUDSMAN
FOR THE PROVINCE
OF SINDH (AMENDMENT) ACT,
2012
An Act to amend the Establishment of the Office of Ombudsman
for
the Province of Sindh Act,
1991.
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV,
5th April, 2012]
No.PAS/Legis-B-04/2012,
dated 2-4-2012.---The Establishment of the Office of Ombudsman for the Province
of Sindh (Amendment) Bill, 2012 having been passed by
the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 5th March, 2012
and assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 21st
March, 2012 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---Whereas it
is expedient to amend the Establishment of the Office of Ombudsman for the Province of Sindh Act,
1991, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as
follows:---
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the Establishment of the Office of Ombudsman
for the Province
of Sindh
(Amendment) Act, 2012.
(2) It shall come into force
at once.

the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 5th March, 2012
and assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 21st
March, 2012 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---Whereas it
is expedient to amend the Establishment of the Office of Ombudsman for the Province of Sindh Act,
1991, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as
follows:---
2. Amendment of section 4 of
Sindh Act No.I of 1992.---In the Establishment of the Office of Ombudsman for
the Province of Sindh Act, 1991, in section 4, for
subsection (1), the following shall be substituted:---
"(1) The Ombudsman shall
hold office for a period of four years:
Provided that the
Governor may, in appropriate case, on the advice of Chief Minister, extend the
term of Ombudsman or reappoint him for a further period as deemed fit."
